verdicts.reason: A breaks the design: the large photo panel on the left is an empty blurred background, and the product bag has shrunk to a tiny thumbnail at the bottom next to the logo. The CTA sits above the headline, breaking the reading order, and the SAVE 15% badge floats on its own, cut off from the rest. B is nearly a straight copy of the original and keeps the hierarchy, brand and bag intact. Its flaws: the image panel leaves odd dark strips at the top and bottom edges instead of filling the canvas, the extra height opens loose vertical spacing in the left column, and the headline still breaks awkwardly ('on / repeat').
